description: This file defines the OpportunitiesByLeadSourceByOutcomeDashlet class, which extends a generic chart dashlet for rendering a specific opportunity report visualization in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for configuring display options, constructing SQL queries for data retrieval, and generating the HTML/JavaScript code to render a chart showing opportunities categorized by lead source and sales stage.

classes.name: OpportunitiesByLeadSourceByOutcomeDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class for visualizing opportunities grouped by lead source and sales outcome, providing configuration and rendering logic specific to this chart.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Configures display options for lead sources and user IDs used for filtering the chart.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the chart visualization, including preparing data, generating JavaScript code for RGraph, and handling user preferences for currency.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to fetch opportunity data aggregated by lead source and sales stage.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Processes raw database results into a structured format suitable for chart rendering, including labels, data points, tooltips, and keys.
